title: Why Reliance made record oil profit while HPCL lost money

outro.text: Until Delhi lets pump prices rise, refiners keep winning and pumps keep losing. And that is why Reliance's oil profit jumped

sources: Times of India / Moneycontrol on Reliance Q2 FY27, Oct. 30, 2026
The Hindu BusinessLine / DSIJ on HPCL Q1-Q2 FY27, Oct. 24, 2026

scenes.hook_card: Reliance oil profit +68%. HPCL lost Rs 8,639 crore.
scenes.text: Reliance's oil profit jumped 68 percent. Its rival lost 8,639 crore rupees.
Reliance's oil arm earned a record 25,203 crore rupees in one quarter.
HPCL's refineries did well too. Its refining margin hit 32 dollars a barrel, up from under 9.
But HPCL also sells at the pump, at prices held since May. That left it with a loss over six months.
Elara Capital estimates state retailers lost about 24 rupees on every litre of diesel.
